subject: Penetration assessment — firm credentials, report validity window, and remediation status
messages:
From: AcmeCorp Security <security@acmecorp.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Pen test report validity and remediation evidence

Hi Mina,

We are finalizing our vendor risk assessment for Redwood as part of contract close and have a couple quick asks on the penetration testing evidence you provided:

- Can you confirm the date of the pen test and whether your vendor's methodology maps to NIST SP 800-115 or OWASP ASVS?
- Our SOC 2 scope requires a report that is no older than 12 months at time of contract signature; please confirm the report validity window and whether there are any supplemental attestations.
- We also need a remediation status update: which findings were rated critical/high and what mitigations are complete vs. in-progress.

If you can share either the full report or an executive summary plus a remediation tracker, that should suffice for our security team. We are on a tight timeline — goal is to finalize in the next 7 business days.

Thanks,
Jordan Evans
AcmeCorp Security

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: AcmeCorp Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Feb 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pen test report validity and remediation evidence

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: we engaged an independent firm (OpticSec Ltd) and the assessment was completed 2026-02-05; OpticSec follows OWASP testing guidance and provides a NIST-aligned methodology. We can provide an executive summary and a remediation tracker today, and the full report under an NDA if required.

I'm looping in Vivek (Head of Infrastructure) and Laura (Legal) to confirm the distribution path for the full report and to attach the remediation tracker.

Next steps:
- I will share the OpticSec executive summary and a high-level remediation tracker in this thread by EOD.
- If Acme requires the full report, we'll coordinate via a one-way NDA and DocuSign.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: jordan.evans@opticsec.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, AcmeCorp Security <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: OpticSec — Redwood penetration assessment deliverables and methodology

Mina, Jordan (Acme) — thanks for the intro. Quick summary of our deliverables and credentials:

- Assessment date: 2026-02-03 to 2026-02-04, report issued 2026-02-05.
- Firm: OpticSec Ltd — commercial penetration testing practice since 2014, CREST-aligned testers, ISO 27001-certified practice.
- Methodology: combination of OWASP Top 10 web app testing, NIST SP 800-115 guidance for technical testing, and internal threat emulation for API endpoints. We include manual verification of findings and CVSSv3 scoring.
- Report scope: external web app + API, admin interfaces, and selected internal services behind VPN (see scope table).
- Validity guidance: many customers accept the report as valid for 12 months from the report issue date; that said, if significant changes occur we recommend re-testing or focused validation.

Attachments: OpticSec_Redwood_Assessment_Summary_20260205.pdf (executive summary, methodology appendix, findings table).

Happy to jump on a quick call if Acme wants a walkthrough of the findings or the test methodology.

—Jordan Evans
Principal Consultant
OpticSec Ltd

From: viva.kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, jordan.evans@opticsec.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OpticSec — Redwood penetration assessment deliverables and methodology

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the methodology notes. Mina: a couple internal clarifications from infra side for Acme's request:

- Can we provide the CVSS and severity categorization used (OpticSec sent CVSSv3 but Acme is asking for a mapping to our internal risk taxonomy)?
- For the 'internal services behind VPN' scope, please confirm whether the assessment included lateral movement testing or only exposed services.
- For remediation statuses, we will populate an internal tracker with ticket links and ETA for in-progress items; attach the tracker when you send it so Acme gets visibility.

I'll also confirm whether any of the items require retest sign-off by OpticSec (critical/high retests).

—Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: AcmeCorp Security <security@acmecorp.com>, jordan.evans@opticsec.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2026 15:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Penetration assessment — firm credentials, report validity window, and remediation status

Jordan/Acme — attaching the executive summary and a remediation tracker export. High-level notes:

- Report issue date: 2026-02-05; this places the report well within a 12-month validity window for contract signature scheduled for Feb/Mar 2026.
- Findings: 1 critical (CVE-2025-9999, fixed 2026-02-07, retest verification completed by OpticSec), 3 high (two remediated, one in progress with ETA 2026-02-20), 6 medium/low (remediated or scheduled in normal release cadence).
- OpticSec performed authenticated API testing and confirmed no lateral movement was achieved; internal scope testing did not include active red-team escalation beyond credentialed enumeration.

Attachments: Redwood_Remediation_Tracker_20260208.xlsx (internal ticket references, status, owner, ETA), OpticSec_Redwood_Assessment_Summary_20260205.pdf (executive summary and methodology appendix).

If Acme needs the full report PDF, Laura — can you advise on our NDA template and distribution process?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: AcmeCorp Security <security@acmecorp.com>

Mina — thank you, this is great and covers our ask. A couple follow-ups:

- Please confirm that OpticSec performed a retest that specifically validated the critical finding was fixed (you mention retest verification). Can OpticSec provide a one-page retest confirmation?
- We will accept the executive summary and remediation tracker for now; if procurement requests the full report we will follow the NDA route.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync with AcmeSEC and Jordan next Tue 2026-02-16 to walk through the high-level findings?

Best,
Jordan Evans
AcmeCorp Security
